policy: All eighteen Commons pages were opened, their on-page licence/PD declarations read; checks of copyright ownership and underlying image/statue/heritage restrictions are NOT completed.
Reported pixels are from Commons file descriptions, not a visual full-resolution sharpness validation.
Reject candidate from hero shortlist if sub-1200 pixels on short side; allow research reuse only, with replacement requested.
Special case: LOC Matson upload is upscaled from 746x1024, therefore not eligible as a genuinely high-resolution original.
Do not merge distinct relics, images, processional replicas or protected works.
No user KEEP/Find another/Not relevant decisions are changed. No licensed photograph is automatically user-approved.
No assets downloaded or published; no contacts, permissions requests or payments.
